note: vespera-bridge performance: the WebFlux streaming executor hands a stream to an idle thread instead of starting a new one per request (threads no longer churn through the keep-alive), and cancelling a queued stream after an ignored second task now removes the real task from the queue. The reactive body gates allocate their hold buffer lazily, pass a large write through uncopied and write held bytes without a toByteArray copy; SpillingGate.pending() reports its real state. VesperaResponse.bodyString decodes in bulk. The servlet header source enumerates getHeaderNames() once, more common request and response header names skip a lowercase or key copy, the proxy completion skips the MDC swap when nothing is logged or observed, include/exclude matching caches its catch-all check, and the internal stash overflow exception no longer captures a stack trace. New JNI bench leg client_echo_text_16k.
